reviews.text: Why have a math example on main page, that’s so hard to understand.. This may be a good app, but you have to pay before you sample it out. Well you do get a three day free trial. But why put as an example of how easy the professor app is to use, a problem that isn’t explained easily. Makes no sense. Maybe honesty. But the math problem is worded like any textbook, I do t see it making it any easier.

quantity over quality. the app has a ton of useful resources! however, personally, i don't particularly like the duolingo layout having locked sections, makes it harder to excel in the areas i need to without having to do others that i already know, because in addition to that, the ai sometimes marks my answers wrong then said the right answer is the one i chose, but i still lose hearts over it and get repremanded💔. this app has a good quantity of resources, just not good quality.
